# Community App Launcher

## Overview

Community App Launcher adds a launcher dashboard and command palette to Community edition.

## Features

- Launcher route at `/odoo/home`
- Search-first app launcher dashboard
- Drag-and-drop app ordering
- Global command palette (`Ctrl + K`)
- Search across apps, menus, and actions

## Compatibility

- Community edition

## Installation

1. Place the module in your addons path.
2. Update the apps list.
3. Install `Community App Launcher`.
